name: Cliedesk – AI Help Desk, Live Chat & Support Ticket System
author: Degird

sections.description:
Cliedesk is a free help desk plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce. Answer live chat, contact forms, emails and support tickets from one shared inbox, publish a knowledge base on your own domain, and let customers follow their requests in a customer portal. Everything runs on your own site, with unlimited agents and no per-seat fees.

Your team works in a fast, full-screen app at /desk (the address can be changed) on desktop and phone, and can install it like an app. All conversations, customers and files stay in your own WordPress database.

Shared inbox and ticket system

  • Chat, forms and portal messages become tickets in one shared team inbox
  • Assign, prioritise, tag, snooze, merge and split conversations; private notes and @mentions
  • Saved replies (canned responses), macros, signatures, scheduled and undo-send replies
  • Collision detection, saved views, search, keyboard shortcuts and a command palette
  • Replies go out by email (WordPress mail or SMTP) with a portal link where customers answer

Live chat widget

  • A light chat widget that knows signed-in customers and their orders
  • Files, images and voice notes; business hours and offline messages
  • Spam protection with Cloudflare Turnstile or hCaptcha; accessible and RTL-ready
  • JavaScript API for developers (Cliedesk.open(), Cliedesk.prefill() and more)

Knowledge base, forms and customer portal

  • Help center articles in the block editor, with categories, search and feedback; they are pages on your domain, so your SEO plugin works with them
  • A ticket request form as a block, a shortcode or its own page, with article suggestions while customers type
  • Customer portal: customers see and answer their own requests; with WooCommerce it is a “Support” tab in My Account

WooCommerce help desk

  • The customer’s orders next to every conversation, read live from WooCommerce (HPOS compatible)
  • Order lookup by number, email, phone, name or product; WooCommerce Subscriptions in the side panel
  • Private and customer order notes from the help desk; order notes in the conversation timeline

Automation, team and reports

  • One-step rules on events with conditions and actions, plus ready-made recipes such as an automatic acknowledgment
  • Queues with round-robin assignment, Online/Away status, business hours, holidays and closure mode
  • Unlimited agents and teams, six roles, an audit log and required 2FA for agents
  • Reports on volume, response and resolution times, backlog, the help center and the chat; CSAT surveys
  • Contacts and organisations with custom fields, segments and a customer timeline
  • Notifications in the app, by email and by browser push; WP-CLI commands and multisite support

Who uses Cliedesk

WooCommerce stores, sellers of plugins, themes and digital products, agencies, and membership or course sites: any team that wants a self-hosted helpdesk instead of a SaaS help desk, with live chat, ticketing and a knowledge base in one plugin.

Cliedesk Pro

Cliedesk Pro is a separate, paid add-on for growing support teams. See the plans at https://cliedesk.com/pricing/

  • AI agent that answers customers on every channel from your help center and orders, and asks a person to approve refunds
  • AI copilot that drafts, rewrites, summarises and translates replies
  • Your own AI key: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock or a local model
  • Email ticketing (IMAP or forwarding), WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, SMS, Slack, Microsoft Teams and voice
  • Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms and Formidable Forms entries as tickets
  • Multi-step workflows, SLA policies, skills-based routing, advanced reports, refunds and returns
  • Several brands, custom roles, private help center, SSO, public API and webhooks
  • Import from Zendesk, Freshdesk, Help Scout, Intercom, Gorgias, Crisp, Fluent Support, Awesome Support or SupportCandy

This plugin does not need Cliedesk Pro. It contains no Pro or AI code, has no trial or locked features, and never locks your data: export and the WordPress privacy tools always work.

Privacy

Cliedesk sends no usage data and has no telemetry. It loads no remote fonts, scripts or analytics. The services listed under “External services” are used only when you turn on the feature that needs them. Privacy tools (export, erase and retention rules) connect to the WordPress privacy tools for GDPR requests.

Source code, bugs and contributing

The source code of the app and chat widget (TypeScript), with the build tools and build steps, is on GitHub: github.com/degird/cliedesk. Report bugs or contribute there.

External services

Cliedesk contacts no external service on its own. These services are used only after you turn on the feature that needs them:

  • Your email server (SMTP): when you add an SMTP connection, Cliedesk connects to the server you enter to send email. Only your login and the emails are exchanged, with the provider you chose.
  • Cloudflare Turnstile or hCaptcha: when you turn on spam protection with one of them, the chat widget and forms load the provider’s check and your site sends the visitor’s answer token to the provider to verify it. Turnstile terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/ Privacy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/ hCaptcha terms: https://www.hcaptcha.com/terms Privacy: https://www.hcaptcha.com/privacy
  • Browser push services: when an agent turns on push notifications, notifications are sent, encrypted, to the push service of that agent’s browser (for example Google, Mozilla or Apple). The message contains the notification text only.
  • Web pages you add as knowledge: when you add a web page or sitemap as a knowledge source, Cliedesk downloads those pages from the addresses you entered.
  • Gravatar (by Automattic): when the Gravatar setting is on, avatars may be loaded from gravatar.com by the browser. The request contains a hash of the email address. Terms: https://automattic.com/tos/ Privacy: https://automattic.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Open your site at /desk (or use Cliedesk in the admin menu) and follow the setup assistant.
  3. Check your sending email in Settings → Channels → Email (send a test email) and turn on the chat widget if you want it.
  4. For reliable background jobs, run WP-Cron from a real server cron.

WP-CLI: wp cliedesk lists all commands. If the app cannot load, Cliedesk → Status in wp-admin shows what is wrong.
sections.faq:
Is the free plugin limited?

No. There are no limits on agents, conversations or products, and no time limit. Cliedesk Pro adds more features, but everything in the free plugin works without it.

Is it a ticket system or a live chat plugin?

Both. Chats, forms and portal messages land in one inbox as tickets, so customers get one answer, wherever they wrote.

Does Cliedesk have an AI chatbot?

The free plugin has no AI. Cliedesk Pro adds an AI agent and an AI copilot with your own AI provider key, with no per-resolution fees.

Can customers answer by email?

Every email from Cliedesk has a “View and reply in the portal” link. The answer is added to the same conversation. Receiving email (a support mailbox, forwarding, or replies by email) needs Cliedesk Pro.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. Cliedesk works on any WordPress site. When WooCommerce is active, orders appear next to conversations automatically.

What happens to my data when I uninstall?

Nothing is deleted. To remove everything, use Settings → Security → Delete all data, or run wp cliedesk data purge --yes. Your WordPress users, pages and orders stay.

Can I change the /desk address?

Yes, in Settings → Workspace → General → App address, or with the CLIEDESK_APP_SLUG constant in wp-config.php. Old links keep working for 90 days. If /desk is already used by a page, Cliedesk picks a free address automatically.

Does Cliedesk work with page caches?

Yes. The app sends no-cache headers, and Setup Health warns when a cache still stores the app page.
sections.changelog:
1.2.5

  • Fixed: an agent’s reply reaches an open chat as soon as its undo window ends, even when the site’s background requests are slow or blocked.
  • Fixed: a reply could be missing from an open chat when the visitor wrote another message during the undo window.

1.2.4

  • Security: with LiteSpeed Cache’s default settings, a visitor’s chat list and a guest’s portal conversations could be served to other people. Cliedesk’s data is now never stored by page caches. Please update.
  • Fixed: with LiteSpeed Cache, agent replies and “is typing” did not reach the chat, and read status was not recorded.
  • Fixed: password-protected help centers are no longer stored by page caches. Public help pages stay cached and refresh when articles or settings change.
  • Fixed: LiteSpeed Cache’s combine and delay options no longer stop the chat from starting.

Full notes and older entries are in changelog.txt.
